Events.Name: DevSoc Social
Events.About:
We will be hosting a social where you are all invited! As well as others such as AI Robotics society and their members.
There will be video games, board games and most importantly there will be free pizza for all!
You should all definitely come along (even if it is for free food).

Events.Name: HackTheTrent
Events.About:
This will be a 6hr Hackathon (this includes speeches, awards and judging). 
You can come with a team, find one on the day or do it solo.
There will also be free snacks, as that usually entices you all, definitely did for me.

archive-Events.Name: Coding Support & DSA (Data Structure Algoritms) introduction workshop
archive-Events.About:
Need help with programming or want to improve your problem-solving skills?
Drop in for a friendly, beginner-friendly session where you can get help with coding, learn about Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA), explore Big O notation and hash maps, and work through practice problems with support from fellow students.
Bring your questions, work on your own code, or learn something new!

Click the more details button to fill the form!
